assertion: Evaluation freezes one ordered fragment version vector plus content and authority identities before loading exact immutable payloads
counterexample: Evaluator loads fragment zero latest then chases newer latest for fragment one
authoritative_observation: manifest vector identities named payload checksums and latest-read spy
close_condition: loaded vector content identities and bytes equal the capture while current advances and load performs zero current reads

assertion: Every fragment owns an independent outer update count
counterexample: A single scalar global step is copied to every fragment regardless of commits
aggregation: all numeric and real Profile A commits
close_condition: only the committed fragment increments and every counter equals its authority version

assertion: Global cycle is the minimum per-fragment outer update count
counterexample: Global cycle uses maximum sum or fastest fragment
aggregation: each asymmetric prefix and final fifty by fifty vector
close_condition: reported global_cycle equals an independent minimum recomputation at every trace row

assertion: Stopping uses a frozen global-cycle wallclock compute token or FLOP budget and never fastest learner local steps
counterexample: Fast learner reaching a local-step threshold stops the system before a slow fragment cycle advances
authoritative_observation: policy identity stop reason budgets and learner step vector
aggregation: target-cycle plus every alternate budget unit test
close_condition: target stop occurs at global_cycle fifty and changing only fastest local steps cannot trigger it

assertion: Reports keep learner local steps and input tokens separate from fragment outer counts global cycle accepted tokens fresh and stale counts
counterexample: One field named global_step conflates all progress
authoritative_observation: typed learner rows fragment rows and derived global_cycle
aggregation: every numeric commit plus four real learner reports
close_condition: all required counters reconcile independently and stale accepted count is zero under Profile A

assertion: The acceptance run makes no quality or efficiency comparison unless matched compute communication or tokens is true
counterexample: An unmatched runtime trace claims a quality or efficiency benefit
close_condition: all matched flags are false and the claim is protocol/runtime acceptance only

assertion: The complete readiness merge atomic-commit path matches the independent oracle at one update and across fifty consecutive updates
counterexample: Production trace copies expected output or bypasses proposal readiness and commit
authoritative_observation: raw current and four raw proposals independently decoded by analyzer and Checker
aggregation: two fragments times fifty contiguous updates
close_condition: single and maximum fifty-update relative L2 are at most 1e-6 and last-ten error does not amplify

assertion: Evaluation manifest immutably binds the frozen vector content identities and payloads
counterexample: Manifest records only versions and evaluator later resolves latest content
authoritative_observation: canonical manifest identity per-fragment checksum and current-read counter
aggregation: concurrent post-capture updates plus restart load
close_condition: manifest validates after restart and exact frozen bytes load without current authority reads

assertion: Slowing exactly one of four independent learner processes to half rate changes each other learner common-interval throughput by at most two percent
counterexample: All learners cross a barrier after every local step so one slowdown halves peer throughput
authoritative_observation: shared ten-second interval local completed step counts host and distributed-state audit
aggregation: control and one-learner slowdown trials on four distinct GPU hosts
close_condition: slow learner ratio is 0.5 plus or minus 0.05 and every other absolute relative change is at most 0.02

assertion: A real HF learner continues finite optimizer steps while its local fragment vector is mixed
counterexample: Training blocks until all fragment versions align or loss becomes nonfinite
authoritative_observation: step loss version vector and safe-boundary adoption trace
aggregation: at least five consecutive post-adoption mixed-version optimizer steps
close_condition: all required mixed-version steps are consecutive finite and no version-alignment wait occurs
